stories.title: El boicot al Festival de las Ideas se lleva por delante a su principal patrocinador

en.title: Boycott of Ideas Festival claims main sponsor
en.summary: Over two dozen participants withdrew from the Ideas Festival in protest against Allianz's sponsorship, citing the insurance company's alleged ties to Israel. Allianz subsequently ended its sponsorship, causing organizers to lose 150,000 euros in funding.

stories.title: No todos los caminos conducían a Roma en la antigüedad: "Bizancio era el punto más estratégico del Imperio romano"

en.title: Not all roads led to Rome in antiquity: "Byzantium was the most strategic point of the Roman Empire"
en.summary: A comprehensive analysis of the Roman road network reveals that Byzantium, Antioch, and Ankara had better connections to the empire than Rome itself, challenging traditional assumptions about the capital's centrality.

stories.title: El Rey se pronuncia por primera vez públicamente sobre Ceuta: «Una situación de extraordinaria complejidad»

en.title: The King speaks publicly for the first time about Ceuta: "An extraordinarily complex situation"
en.summary: Spain's King Felipe VI publicly addressed the mass assault on the autonomous city of Ceuta for the first time, describing it as extraordinarily complex and praising the response from civil protection personnel and other public servants.

stories.title: No todos los caminos conducían a Roma

en.title: Not all roads led to Rome
en.summary: An international research team reconstructed the Roman road system and found that Byzantium had better connectivity than Rome during the empire's peak in the late second century, contrary to popular belief.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza aplicar la amnistía a Puigdemont por la malversación

en.title: Llarena rejects applying amnesty to Puigdemont for embezzlement
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court judge Pablo Llarena has denied former Catalan president Carles Puigdemont's request for amnesty application, keeping an arrest warrant active against him for embezzlement charges related to independence process activities.

stories.title: Felipe VI recuerda en su primer discurso tras el asalto a Ceuta que la ciudad continúa "inmersa en una situación de extrema complejidad"

en.title: King Felipe VI recalls in his first speech after Ceuta assault that the city remains in a situation of extreme complexity
en.summary: Spain's King Felipe VI delivered his first public remarks on the Ceuta crisis, describing the situation as extremely complex, while the Interior Minister emphasized government support for the affected population.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza aplicar la amnistía a Puigdemont y mantiene la orden nacional de detención contra el líder de Junts

en.title: Llarena rejects applying amnesty to Puigdemont and maintains national arrest warrant against Junts leader
en.summary: The Supreme Court judge has upheld his refusal to apply amnesty to fugitive Carles Puigdemont, citing the misappropriation of funds for personal financial benefit as grounds for maintaining the arrest warrant.

stories.title: El Rey reconoce el trabajo de servidores públicos y voluntarios en la “situación de extraordinaria complejidad” que sufre Ceuta

en.title: The King acknowledges the work of public servants and volunteers in the extraordinary complexity situation affecting Ceuta
en.summary: King Felipe VI publicly commented on the Ceuta crisis for the first time, recognizing the efforts of public employees and volunteers managing the exceptionally complex situation.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza levantar la orden de detención de Puigdemont a la espera del TC

en.title: Llarena rejects lifting Puigdemont's arrest warrant pending TC ruling
en.summary: A Supreme Court judge argues that a European Court of Justice ruling did not address an exception in the law regarding embezzlement charges, maintaining the arrest warrant against the former Catalan president.

stories.title: Llarena rechaza aplicar la amnistía a Puigdemont por el delito de malversación tras el aval del TJUE a la ley

en.title: Llarena refuses to apply amnesty to Puigdemont for embezzlement following TJUE backing of law
en.summary: The Supreme Court judge maintains an arrest warrant against the former Catalan president for embezzlement charges while leaving open the possibility of applying amnesty at a later stage.

stories.title: El Rey se pronuncia por primera vez sobre Ceuta y alerta de la “extraordinaria complejidad” de la situación

en.title: King addresses Ceuta situation for first time and warns of 'extraordinary complexity'
en.summary: Spain's King Felipe VI publicly comments on the Ceuta situation for the first time, acknowledging the substantial work being carried out by Civil Protection personnel.

stories.title: Podemos lanza a su número tres, Pablo Fernández, como candidato a la Alcaldía de Madrid

en.title: Podemos launches its number three, Pablo Fernández, as candidate for Madrid Mayor
en.summary: Podemos has launched Pablo Fernández, the party's organizational secretary, as its candidate for Madrid's mayoral position. He advocates for shifting Madrid from speculation-driven policies toward making housing affordable for residents.

stories.title: El Ibex salva la sesión y cierra en tablas pese a la presión del petróleo y la deuda

en.title: Ibex holds session and closes flat despite pressure from oil and debt
en.summary: The Spanish Ibex index ended the day unchanged as oil prices, debt concerns, and Federal Reserve decisions pressured markets, though it managed to partially recover from previous losses linked to AI-related stocks.

stories.title: Mark Carney insta a la UE a consolidar el acuerdo comercial mientras Ottawa busca alejarse de Estados Unidos

en.title: Mark Carney urges EU to consolidate trade agreement while Ottawa seeks to distance itself from United States
en.summary: Canada's prime minister advocates for stronger ties with Europe, arguing they would make both regions more resilient against destabilization caused by Trump.

stories.title: El IESE ficha al expresidente de la escuela suiza IMD

en.title: IESE recruits former president of Swiss school IMD
en.summary: IESE strengthens its faculty by hiring Jean-François Manzoni, an expert in leadership, organizational development, and corporate governance.

stories.title: Ya está disponible iOS 27, la actualización del iPhone que llega a España sin Siri AI

en.title: iOS 27 is now available, the iPhone update that arrives in Spain without Siri AI
en.summary: Apple has begun distributing iOS 27 with an updated Siri AI assistant, though users in Spain and the EU will need to wait for access to the integrated AI features.

stories.title: Los aliados de Irán presionan a Arabia Saudí 'en todos los frentes'

en.title: Iran's allies pressure Saudi Arabia "on all fronts"
en.summary: Simultaneous attacks by Houthi rebels and Iraqi militias represent a significant challenge for Prince Mohammed, comparable to backlash from previous controversial events.
